name: AIENG EOS Authored-Source Reconciliation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/aieng-eos-code-20260907
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/aieng-eos-code.yml

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  reconcile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout authored reconciliation baseline
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: 0cbffe7d4f8e2bd9aab479fd24718311ec5b6ad4

      - name: Configure Git identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "Monad EOS Automation"
          git config user.email "eos-automation@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Fetch closed legacy source branch
        run: git fetch origin eosp/ai-driven-engineering-operating-model

      - name: Assert safe pre-fix ancestry equivalence
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          assert_blob() {
            local path="$1"
            local ref="$2"
            local current source
            current="$(git hash-object "$path")"
            source="$(git rev-parse "$ref:$path")"
            if [[ "$current" != "$source" ]]; then
              echo "unsafe authored-source replacement: $path diverged from expected pre-fix source" >&2
              echo "current=$current expected=$source" >&2
              exit 41
            fi
          }

          # MNT-0005 surfaces: current baseline is exactly the pre-repair source.
          assert_blob .eos/domain-model.json 17dca2edf9156f4a20e8b87205bf27ed97355f3c
          assert_blob .eos/schemas/core/requirement.schema.json 17dca2edf9156f4a20e8b87205bf27ed97355f3c
          assert_blob .eos/schemas/core/specification.schema.json 17dca2edf9156f4a20e8b87205bf27ed97355f3c
          assert_blob tools/eos/eos.py 17dca2edf9156f4a20e8b87205bf27ed97355f3c
          assert_blob tools/eos/execution_v2.py 17dca2edf9156f4a20e8b87205bf27ed97355f3c
          assert_blob tools/eos/verification_v2_impl.py 17dca2edf9156f4a20e8b87205bf27ed97355f3c

          # MNT-0006 surfaces: current baseline is exactly the pre-atomicity source.
          assert_blob scripts/eos b1d3f7733aa1f547057d6372bd45f261f5b50b02
          assert_blob tools/eos/canonical_state.py b1d3f7733aa1f547057d6372bd45f261f5b50b02
          assert_blob tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py b1d3f7733aa1f547057d6372bd45f261f5b50b02
          assert_blob tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py b1d3f7733aa1f547057d6372bd45f261f5b50b02

          # MNT-0003 integration surface is exactly its pre-hardening source.
          assert_blob scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py 312c045df983f7d310caf6bfe1afc1e2113ceec3

      - name: Forward-port final authored EOS implementations
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source_ref="origin/eosp/ai-driven-engineering-operating-model"

          for path in \
            .eos/domain-model.json \
            .eos/schemas/core/requirement.schema.json \
            .eos/schemas/core/specification.schema.json \
            scripts/eos \
            scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py \
            tools/eos/canonical_state.py \
            tools/eos/eos.py \
            tools/eos/event_ledger.py \
            tools/eos/execution_v2.py \
            tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py \
            tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py \
            tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py
          do
            git show "$source_ref:$path" > "$path"
          done

          # Modern main has a scope-sensitive EOSV facade. Preserve it and put
          # the final legacy EOSV implementation behind that facade.
          git show "$source_ref:tools/eos/verification_v2.py" > tools/eos/verification_v2_impl.py

      - name: Assert no generated-state or evidence import
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import subprocess

          allowed = {
              '.eos/domain-model.json',
              '.eos/schemas/core/requirement.schema.json',
              '.eos/schemas/core/specification.schema.json',
              'scripts/eos',
              'scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py',
              'tools/eos/canonical_state.py',
              'tools/eos/eos.py',
              'tools/eos/event_ledger.py',
              'tools/eos/execution_v2.py',
              'tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py',
              'tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py',
              'tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py',
              'tools/eos/verification_v2_impl.py',
          }
          changed = set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'], text=True).splitlines())
          unexpected = sorted(changed - allowed)
          missing = sorted(allowed - changed)
          if unexpected:
              raise SystemExit('unexpected reconciliation mutations: ' + ', '.join(unexpected))
          if missing:
              raise SystemExit('expected authored changes absent: ' + ', '.join(missing))
          prohibited = [
              p for p in changed
              if p.startswith('machine/')
              or p.startswith('engineering/evidence/')
              or p.startswith('.eos/evidence/')
              or p in {
                  '.eos/events.jsonl',
                  '.eos/evidence.tsv',
                  '.eos/evidence-links.tsv',
                  '.eos/maintenance.tsv',
                  '.eos/state/current.json',
                  '.eos/state/projections.json',
                  '.eos/trace-edges.tsv',
              }
          ]
          if prohibited:
              raise SystemExit('generated/evidence mutation forbidden: ' + ', '.join(sorted(prohibited)))
          print(f'authored reconciliation boundary: PASS ({len(changed)} changed paths)')
          PY

      - name: Static validation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --check
          bash -n scripts/eos
          python3 -m py_compile \
            scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py \
            tools/eos/canonical_state.py \
            tools/eos/eos.py \
            tools/eos/event_ledger.py \
            tools/eos/execution_v2.py \
            tools/eos/identity_families.py \
            tools/eos/verification_v2.py \
            tools/eos/verification_v2_impl.py \
            tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py \
            tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py \
            tools/eos/test_identifier_families.py \
            tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py

      - name: Run authored-source regression suites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/eos/test_identifier_families.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py

      - name: Verify tests caused no projection churn
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import subprocess
          allowed = {
              '.eos/domain-model.json',
              '.eos/schemas/core/requirement.schema.json',
              '.eos/schemas/core/specification.schema.json',
              'scripts/eos',
              'scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py',
              'tools/eos/canonical_state.py',
              'tools/eos/eos.py',
              'tools/eos/event_ledger.py',
              'tools/eos/execution_v2.py',
              'tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py',
              'tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py',
              'tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py',
              'tools/eos/verification_v2_impl.py',
          }
          changed = set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'], text=True).splitlines())
          unexpected = sorted(changed - allowed)
          if unexpected:
              raise SystemExit('tests produced integration-sensitive churn: ' + ', '.join(unexpected))
          print('no generated-state churn: PASS')
          PY

      - name: Commit reconciled authored source
        run: |
          git add \
            .eos/domain-model.json \
            .eos/schemas/core/requirement.schema.json \
            .eos/schemas/core/specification.schema.json \
            scripts/eos \
            scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py \
            tools/eos/canonical_state.py \
            tools/eos/eos.py \
            tools/eos/event_ledger.py \
            tools/eos/execution_v2.py \
            tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py \
            tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py \
            tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py \
            tools/eos/verification_v2_impl.py
          git diff --cached --check
          git commit -m "fix(eos): forward-port AIENG maintenance hardening"

      - name: Publish immutable authored result
        run: git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/automation/aieng-eos-code-result-20260907
